caption: The drawing features a rectangular strip with slightly curved upper edges, predominantly filled with a dark brown or black background. Centered within the strip are two large, stylized flowers rendered in shades of yellow and brown. Each flower has rounded petals radiating outward and a detailed central area. Surrounding the two main flowers are several smaller flowers and leaves, also in shades of yellow and brown, with their shapes clearly outlined. The composition creates a symmetrical floral arrangement spanning the width of the strip, with the floral motifs densely packed and overlapping in places. The rest of the drawing outside this decorated strip is an unadorned, light beige background.
title: Boston Rocker
